responsibility: Defines the IQ2000 target option table consumed by GCC’s option-generator machinery. It introduces the backend’s -march, -mcpu, and target feature switches, binds them to target masks or the iq2000_tune variable and processor_type enum, documents accepted CPU names, and arranges inclusion of iq2000-opts.h, thereby controlling how command-line options select code-generation and scheduling behavior for this port.
same_name_distinction: This is the option-definition file for the IQ2000 backend, feeding GCC’s option generator with -march, -mcpu, and target-mask settings plus accepted CPU names and the iq2000_tune variable binding. Unlike iq2000.cc, it implements no backend code; unlike iq2000.h, it does not define the machine model macros; unlike iq2000.md, it does not describe RTL instructions, attributes, or delay-slot behavior.
